lot_size_in_base.meaning: market lotSizeInBase, the minimum tradeable base-asset lot; configured to 1 ether

resting_sell_amount.meaning: base-asset amount the resting limit sell order offers, 100 ether

fok_buy_amount.meaning: base-asset amount the FOK taker order requests, 100.5 ether

amount_remaining_after_matching.meaning: newOrder.amount left after the matching engine filled the tradeable portion; 0.5 ether in the reported scenario
amount_remaining_after_matching.checkpoint: after matching fills, before completeness check

transaction_reverted.meaning: whether the postFillOrder transaction reverts with FOKOrderNotFilled()

assumptions: A remaining portion smaller than one lotSizeInBase is fundamentally untradeable and therefore no longer part of the fillable tradeable amount.

unresolved.description: Report does not define the exact predicate that distinguishes an unfilled tradeable remainder from an untradeable dust remainder; the plan uses amount_remaining_after_matching < lotSizeInBase as the report-grounded dust condition from root-cause and intent wording.

limitations: Only the direct revert impact i_revert_not_filled is formalized; i_fok_unreliable is deferred as a downstream reliability consequence of the same defect.
The report does not state whether the scenario transaction was executed on-chain; no runtime binding or concrete execution is claimed.
No transaction reverting result is claimed as a valid operation; this plan only formalizes that a sub-lotSizeInBase dust remainder must not by itself cause the revert.
